assessment_type: Applied internal technical preparation rubric; not certification, owner acceptance or permission to publish

criteria.definition: Identidad inmutable de las fuentes revisadas
criteria.original_requirement: Vincular una evaluación posterior a los bytes finales de entrega si cambian
criteria.reason: The sealed immutable 698-file snapshot remains identified. Original A13 distributions retain their six hashes; the earlier independent evidence check matched 114 current src files to the frozen snapshot and existing installed identity receipts bind 127 core payload members. Current later driver/workflow/documentation changes remain expressly outside the sealed source scan.

criteria.definition: Inventario de alcance y cobertura completa acordada
criteria.original_requirement: Completar o aprobar explícitamente el alcance restante; no sustituir lectura con búsquedas
criteria.reason: Whole-repository review is incomplete: 319/698 files reviewed, 379 without full reading and 122 fixture corpus files omitted. No owner approval of the remaining scope is inferred.

criteria.definition: Modelo de amenazas independiente con recursos efectivos
criteria.original_requirement: Revisión y aceptación del responsable del despliegue
criteria.reason: Fresh-context independent architecture model exists with 43 resources/consumers and verified citations. Acceptance by the deployment owner remains pending.

criteria.definition: Contratos/JSON cerrados y regresiones negativas verificadas
criteria.original_requirement: Vincular pruebas negativas realmente ejecutadas al candidato final
criteria.reason: Previously read and hash-checked A13 installed JUnit receipts and unchanged test sources prove executed negative JSON/contract regressions, including duplicate/nonstandard JSON, invalid UTF-8/surrogates and invalid model_copy serialization. The claim is tied to the exact A13 candidate and tested environment.

criteria.definition: Confinamiento de archivos/bundles y rechazo de redirecciones
criteria.original_requirement: Corregir junctions y ejecutar regresiones Windows/normal/POSIX; decidir endurecimiento de archivos especiales
criteria.reason: Validated low-severity Windows directory-junction finding remains open. No SDK fix, PoC or junction regression was performed in this evidence review.

criteria.definition: Autoridad explícita de SQL/callbacks/plugins
criteria.original_requirement: Mantener política de código confiable y verificar integración del consumidor
criteria.reason: Reviewed source requires explicit trusted SQL/callback/plugin authority; IR is closed. Existing A13 independent synthetic consumer receipts execute native engine integrations and negative acceptance cases. This is not sandboxing or external adoption.

criteria.definition: Persistencia de detectores sin restauración ejecutable
criteria.original_requirement: Regresiones de deserialización/forma sobre bytes finales
criteria.reason: Reviewed declarative detector persistence is supported by executed A13 negative regressions for eight corrupted bundle variants, invalid tree topology, duplicate JSON keys/nonfinite values and failed measurements. Test source hashes remain unchanged.

criteria.definition: Salidas minimizadas/escapadas y divulgación explícita
criteria.original_requirement: Validar vistas del consumidor y decisiones de compartición/retención
criteria.reason: Static minimization/escaping and unit regressions exist. Consumer view validation and explicit sharing/retention decisions are not established as complete.

criteria.definition: Recursos y limpieza con límites correctamente atribuidos
criteria.original_requirement: Ejecutar casos acotados y comprobar límites OS/container según uso
criteria.reason: Historical bounded resource evidence refers to A8 and incomplete I/O instrumentation. New resources/all probes check psutil availability and positive observed RSS, not host quotas or complete budget/cleanup cases. Applicable OS/container limits remain unproved.

criteria.definition: Egreso y credenciales con destinos/autoridad explícitos
criteria.original_requirement: Validar el entorno offline/egreso permitido si se promete aislamiento
criteria.reason: Reviewed production source and recorded public-only advisory plans/receipts establish explicit destinations and authority. No verified network-isolation promise is made; trusted SQL, callbacks, engines and injected clients may use networking.

criteria.definition: Build/CI/release con referencias y gates revisados
criteria.original_requirement: Verificar la corrección posterior sobre bytes finales y ejecutar ensayo autorizado sin inventar Actions
criteria.reason: PASS under the frozen literal requirement: references/gates were reviewed, the modified release-candidate workflow bytes were read completely, both other workflows match the fully reviewed sealed snapshot, and the authorized manual prepare-scan -> scan -> verify CLI sequence exercises the corrected public-allowlist/request-plan arguments against exact A13 artifacts/locks. Independent offline --require-clean --max-age-hours 24 verification passed for both projects. Neither complete Bash execution nor a complete GitHub job/Actions run is claimed.

criteria.definition: Hallazgos validados con trazas/contrapruebas y gravedad
criteria.original_requirement: Triage del propietario del producto
criteria.reason: Canonical finding has source-to-sink evidence, counterchecks, preconditions and severity. Product-owner triage remains pending.

criteria.definition: Remediación y regresión de cada hallazgo relevante
criteria.original_requirement: Fix explícito, prueba Windows y verificación independiente; o aceptación de riesgo documentada por responsable
criteria.reason: The low Windows finding remains open. Neither correction/regression nor explicit responsible risk acceptance is established.

criteria.definition: SBOM/inventario y hashes vinculados al artefacto final
criteria.original_requirement: Generar y validar inventario/SBOM por wheel/sdist exactos con hashes
criteria.reason: Independent offline validation proved four A13 CycloneDX 1.6 documents, artifact/metadata hashes and sizes, lock/pyproject bindings including original sdist members, closed graphs and local core wheel binding. Scope is the recorded Windows CPython 3.12.4 lock graph; development/build components not installed are explicitly marked.

criteria.definition: Advisories actuales por perfil/resolución final
criteria.original_requirement: Unir recibos fechados y perfiles exactos; revisión de paquetes privados y pendientes restantes
criteria.reason: Artifact-bound current public PyPI/OSV queries are complete for the recorded Windows lock union, with 67 core public distributions and 62 benchmark public distributions, zero known findings and zero unknown queries. Other platforms/profile resolutions, excluded private code and pip outside the lock remain outside that query coverage; no complete S15 approval is inferred.

criteria.definition: Retirada/rollback documentados y comprobados
criteria.original_requirement: Vincular ensayo real por candidato/plataforma y propietario operativo
criteria.reason: An isolated Windows A12 -> A13 -> A12 -> A13 lifecycle receipt binds exact payloads and three result states, but does not by itself establish the prescribed fresh-environment rollback with previous pins and an operational owner.

criteria.definition: Uso seguro, permisos, retención y datos sensibles
criteria.original_requirement: Aprobar permisos/retención/canal y comprobarlo en consumidor real
criteria.reason: Safe-use guidance exists. Approved retention/permissions/channel decisions and validation of the real consumer environment remain incomplete.

criteria.definition: Responsable de seguridad y canal privado verificados
criteria.original_requirement: Nombrar titular/suplente y verificar canal autorizado
criteria.reason: Security owner/deputy and verified private reporting channel have not been assigned/accepted.

criteria.definition: Flujo de respuesta, severidad, SLA y seguimiento
criteria.original_requirement: Aprobar flujo, plazos y simulacro sanitizado
criteria.reason: Response flow, deadlines/SLA and a sanitized exercise have not been approved/completed.

criteria.definition: Revisión humana independiente del candidato y gates
criteria.original_requirement: Revisor independiente identificado, recibo sobre hashes exactos y decisiones explícitas
criteria.reason: Independent human review remains pending. Automated reviewers and this receipt do not satisfy that gate.

method: 20 binary criteria, 5 percentage points each; partial, pending and FAIL0. Definitions and original scope preserved. Root applies the independently reviewed evidence recommendations as a technical measurement; gates remain open.

s11.execution_kind: Authorized manual CLI/Python commands executed separately; independent offline verification repeated during this review

limits: Point-in-time, exact versions and recorded Windows marker environment/lock only.
Other declared versions, platforms and interpreter resolutions are not made current by this query.
Private components are excluded from public requests; the partial source scan is separate.
Pip/tooling outside the lock require separate identified-environment receipts.
Vendored native libraries and OS packages are not exhaustively inventoried.
No direct GHSA API query was executed.

scope_limits: Exact original A13 artifact hashes and the tested Windows lock/marker environment are separate from the sealed source snapshot.
319/698 reviewed; 379 files remain without full review; one low severity finding remains open.
Current follow-up tools/documentation are not retroactively part of the sealed source scan.
No claim of a whole environment without advisories, host isolation or all platform resolutions.
Prepared VM transfer has not executed and is not evidence.
